newsitem.title: FINLAND: ENSO SAYS DLR MAY ADD FIM 100 MLN IN 1997.
newsitem.headline: ENSO SAYS DLR MAY ADD FIM 100 MLN IN 1997.

text.p: Finland's second largest forest industry group Enso Oy said on Wednesday full-year earnings would rise by 100 million markka this year if the dollar stays at its current level.
"If exchange rates (dollar) stay at the current level, there will be a 100 million markka profit improvement," Enso finance director Esko Makelainen told a news conference.
He said this would be seen after financial items. @

In 1996, Enso posted a 1.67 billion markka profit after financial items, and Enso said in its first half interim report that the full-year result would improve. Its first half profit was 928 million markka, down from 1.12 a year earlier.
